migrations.20261022_initialize_dataset_v: First verify and remove the legacy global HNSW index online. Once removal succeeds, count existing Dataset vectors in the background and schedule FP16 partial indexes for Datasets with more than 10,000 vectors. Index jobs run without a delay, one at a time globally. Migration completion does not mean all partial indexes are ready. Exact search remains available while indexes are being built.
Counted {{scannedCount}} datasets; {{eligibleCount}} met the index threshold. Index builds continue in the queue.

migrations.20261104_backfill_chat_publis: Backfill historical call sources in an independent background task after startup, preserving all legacy fields.
migrations.20261104_backfill_openapi_key: Independently scan all API keys in background batches, fill missing types as personal, and normalize valid app IDs to BSON ObjectId values while preserving default targets, credentials, and permissions.
migrations.20261112_backfill_stt_pricing: Backfill legacy STT prices as duration-based in the background, preserving rates and existing token pricing without blocking startup.
migrations.20261111_migrate_sandbox_to_j: Migrate Agent sandbox workspaces to JuiceFS (v3)

Migrate legacy v2 sandbox workspaces (including legacy K8s PVCs, Docker named volumes, S3 archive packages, and remote Sealos Devbox instances) into JuiceFS and write v3 instance records. All legacy storage and v2 records are preserved for rollback until cleanup is triggered. Deployments without sandboxes complete immediately.

migrations.20261111_cleanup_legacy_sandb: Clean up legacy v2 sandbox storage and instances

Run manually after verifying the JuiceFS v3 sandbox upgrade and confirming rollback is no longer needed. Permanently removes legacy containers, unlabeled volumes, S3 archive packages, Sealos Devbox instances, and legacy v2 collection records.
